data.name: Ekagra
data.long_meaning: Ekagra refers to one who has undivided attention, focus, and concentration towards a single goal or thought. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'eka' meaning 'one' and 'agra' meaning 'front' or 'highest'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is also referred to as Ekagrya, signifying his unwavering devotion towards meditation and self-realization.
